description: This file implements system-on-chip (SoC) abstraction functions related to initialization, deinitialization, and volume control for Realtek hardware within the SystemAudioPlayer project.

methods.name: Soc_Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the SoC abstraction layer (currently empty implementation).

methods.name: Soc_Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the SoC abstraction layer (currently empty implementation).

methods.name: SoC_ChangePrimaryVol
methods.description: Changes the primary audio volume if the gain parameter equals MIXGAIN_PRIM.
